**GPP-VPD plots**
- Data density varies - some sites rarely experience high VPD
- Scale differences 
- Nonlinear responses

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(hexbin)
library(patchwork)

# Create site metadata (add PFT and moisture info)
site_meta <- tibble(
  site_code = c("How", "Ade", "Das", "Dap", "Dry", "Stp", "Asm",
                "Cum", "Emr", "Fog", "Gin", "Gww", "Lox",
                "Rdf", "Rig", "Rob", "TTE", "Wac", "Whr",
                "Wom", "Ync", "Cpr", "Tum"),
  PFT = c("WSA", "WSA", "SAV", "GRA", "SAV", "GRA", "SAV",
          "EBF", "GRA", "WET", "WSA", "SAV", "DBF",
          "WSA", "GRA", "EBF", "GRA", "EBF", "EBF",
          "EBF", "GRA", "SAV", "EBF"),
  moisture = c("Wet", "Wet", "Wet", "Wet", "Medium", "Medium", "Dry",
               "Medium", "Medium", "Wet", "Medium", "Dry", "Dry",
               "Wet", "Dry", "Wet", "Dry", "Wet", "Dry",
               "Medium", "Dry", "Dry", "Medium")
)

# List of your site names (matching your dataframe naming convention)
aus_sites <- c("How", "Ade", "Das", "Dap", "Dry", "Stp", "Asm",
               "Cum", "Emr", "Fog", "Gin", "Gww", "Lox",
               "Rdf", "Rig", "Rob", "TTE", "Wac", "Whr",
               "Wom", "Ync", "Cpr", "Tum")
```

1. Hexbin plot

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(hexbin)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)  # ADD THIS

# Function for hexbin plot with density
plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin <- function(site_code) {
  
  # Get data
  data <- get(paste0(site_code, "_HH_daily")) %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP)
  
  # Get site info
  site_info <- site_meta %>% filter(site_code == !!site_code)
  
  # Count data points in VPD bins for density plot
  vpd_density <- data %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(VPD)), by = 0.3))) %>%
    count(vpd_bin) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(vpd_mid = seq(0.15, by = 0.3, length.out = n()))
  
  # Main hexbin plot
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = VPD, y = GPP)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 30, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5), 
                color = "red", linewidth = 1.2, se = TRUE,
                fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", trans = "log10", 
                         name = "Count") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(site_code, " (", site_info$PFT, ", ", site_info$moisture, ")"),
      x = NULL, 
      y = expression(GPP~(gC~m^-2~d^-1))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  
  # Data density histogram
  p2 <- ggplot(vpd_density, aes(x = vpd_mid, y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "gray40", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.25) +
    labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "N obs") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9))  # FIXED THIS LINE
  
  # Combine
  p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1))
}

# Example: Plot for a few sites
plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("TTE")
plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("Rob")
plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("Whr")

# Multi-panel figure
plots_hexbin <- list(
  plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("TTE"),
  plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("Rob"),
  plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("Whr"),
  plot_vpd_gpp_hexbin("Gin")
)

grid.arrange(grobs = plots_hexbin, ncol = 2)
```

2. Truncate at data thresholds

```{r}
# Function to find VPD threshold with adequate data
find_vpd_threshold <- function(data, min_n = 50) {
  data %>%
    arrange(desc(VPD)) %>%
    mutate(cumsum_n = row_number()) %>%
    filter(cumsum_n >= min_n) %>%
    summarise(vpd_95th = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(vpd_95th)
}

# Function for truncated plot
plot_vpd_gpp_truncated <- function(site_code) {
  
  # Get data
  data <- get(paste0(site_code, "_HH_daily")) %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP)
  
  # Get site info
  site_info <- site_meta %>% filter(site_code == !!site_code)
  
  # Find 95th percentile where we have at least 50 observations beyond
  vpd_max <- find_vpd_threshold(data, min_n = 50)
  
  # Filter data
  data_plot <- data %>% filter(VPD <= vpd_max)
  
  ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = VPD, y = GPP)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8, color = "gray50") +
    geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5),
                color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1.5, se = TRUE, 
                fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.2) +
    # Show where we truncated
    geom_vline(xintercept = vpd_max, linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "gray30", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = vpd_max, y = max(data_plot$GPP) * 0.95,
             label = "Data limit\n(95th %ile)",
             hjust = -0.1, size = 3, color = "gray20") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(site_code, " (", site_info$PFT, ", ", site_info$moisture, ")"),
      x = "VPD (kPa)",
      y = expression(GPP~(gC~m^-2~d^-1))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

# Examples
plot_vpd_gpp_truncated("TTE")
plot_vpd_gpp_truncated("Rob")
plot_vpd_gpp_truncated("Cpr")
plot_vpd_gpp_truncated("Asm")


```


3. Normalise GPP for comparison

```{r}
# Function to normalize GPP
normalize_gpp <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      GPP_norm = (GPP - min(GPP, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                 (max(GPP, na.rm = TRUE) - min(GPP, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
}

# Combine all sites with normalized GPP
all_sites_normalized <- aus_sites %>%
  map_dfr(~ {
    data <- get(paste0(.x, "_HH_daily")) %>%
      drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
      normalize_gpp() %>%
      select(VPD, GPP_norm) %>%
      mutate(site = .x)
    data
  }) %>%
  left_join(site_meta, by = c("site" = "site_code"))

# Plot all sites together with normalized GPP
all_sites_normalized %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VPD, y = GPP_norm, group = site, color = moisture)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 4), 
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~PFT, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Wet" = "dodgerblue", 
                                 "Medium" = "purple", 
                                 "Dry" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    x = "VPD (kPa)",
    y = "Normalized GPP (0-1)",
    title = "VPD-GPP response curves across Australian ecosystems",
    subtitle = "Grouped by plant functional type",
    color = "Moisture regime"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Alternative: facet by moisture regime instead
all_sites_normalized %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VPD, y = GPP_norm, group = site, color = PFT)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 4), 
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~moisture, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "VPD (kPa)",
    y = "Normalized GPP (0-1)",
    title = "VPD-GPP response curves by moisture regime",
    color = "PFT"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
Truncated to prevent the flicking up at the end:
```{r}
# Truncate each site to its 95th percentile VPD before plotting
all_sites_normalized_truncated <- aus_sites %>%
  map_dfr(~ {
    data <- get(paste0(.x, "_HH_daily")) %>%
      drop_na(VPD, GPP)
    
    # Get 95th percentile for THIS site
    vpd_95 <- quantile(data$VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    data %>%
      filter(VPD <= vpd_95) %>%  # Truncate BEFORE normalizing
      normalize_gpp() %>%
      select(VPD, GPP_norm) %>%
      mutate(site = .x)
  }) %>%
  left_join(site_meta, by = c("site" = "site_code"))

# Now plot - no more weird upticks!
all_sites_normalized_truncated %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VPD, y = GPP_norm, group = site, color = moisture)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 4), 
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~PFT, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Wet" = "dodgerblue", 
                                 "Medium" = "purple", 
                                 "Dry" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(
    x = "VPD (kPa)",
    y = "Normalized GPP (0-1)",
    title = "VPD-GPP response curves across Australian ecosystems",
    subtitle = "Truncated to 95th percentile VPD per site",
    color = "Moisture regime"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

4. Binned means with sample sizes

```{r}
library(gridExtra)

# Function for binned means plot
plot_vpd_gpp_binned <- function(site_code) {
  
  # Get data
  data <- get(paste0(site_code, "_HH_daily")) %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP)
  
  # Get site info
  site_info <- site_meta %>% filter(site_code == !!site_code)
  
  # Create VPD bins and calculate means
  binned <- data %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(VPD)), by = 0.3))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      gpp_mean = mean(GPP, na.rm = TRUE),
      gpp_se = sd(GPP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 10) %>%  # Only show bins with at least 10 observations
    drop_na()
  
  ggplot(binned, aes(x = vpd_mid, y = gpp_mean)) +
    # Point size represents sample size
    geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.7, color = "firebrick") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = gpp_mean - gpp_se, ymax = gpp_mean + gpp_se),
                  width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = "firebrick") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "firebrick", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), name = "N obs") +
    labs(
      title = paste0(site_code, " (", site_info$PFT, ", ", site_info$moisture, ")"),
      x = "VPD (kPa)",
      y = expression(GPP~(gC~m^-2~d^-1)),
      subtitle = "Points sized by sample size; error bars show ±SE"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

# Examples
plot_vpd_gpp_binned("TTE")
plot_vpd_gpp_binned("Rob")
plot_vpd_gpp_binned("Whr")

# Multi-panel
plots_binned <- lapply(c("TTE", "Ync", "Cpr"), 
                       plot_vpd_gpp_binned)
grid.arrange(grobs = plots_binned, ncol = 2)
```
